answer: Pair a marble identity base with pigment-accrued weight and a velvet friction gate. Each identity gets a marble slab whose grain reflects its timeline, so histories cannot be bulk-minted. Weight, like pigment, is layered through real work—not bought—and needs time to mature. New identities pass a velvet gate of timelocks and liveness proofs, so each clone bears its own setup cost. Sybils share marble-grain and pigment patterns; clustering exposes a cohort whose members forfeit layers together, making fakes costlier than one honest reputation.
